sub_sector.value: contract manufacturing of sportswear and outerwear apparel

product_category.detail: Ready-made sportswear and outerwear manufactured in Jordan for global brands.

market_position.detail: Contract maker for mainstream global sport and outerwear brands such as Adidas, New Balance and American Eagle.

distribution_model.detail: Sells custom-manufactured garments directly to global apparel brands under contract, not to consumers.

purchase_frequency.detail: Consumers buy sport and outerwear garments periodically, mostly seasonally.

notes: Business-to-business contract manufacturer; consumer-facing facets reflect its brand customers' end products.
